title: Rooms, chat, and staffed moderation readiness

capabilitiesVerified.twoParticipantJourney: Alice provisions room, invites Bob, Bob accepts via single-use token; role starts as editor.
capabilitiesVerified.roleTransitions: Owner promotes/demotes member; editor has write privileges; viewer receives 403 FORBIDDEN on mutation attempts.
capabilitiesVerified.ownershipTransfer: Owner transfers ownership to Bob; Bob becomes owner; Alice becomes editor; room invariant (exactly one owner) preserved.
capabilitiesVerified.personalItemCopy: Explicit copy creates new entity UUID in room; personal original intact; vault and journal items strictly rejected.
capabilitiesVerified.chatSequenceAndReplay: Server order sequences maintained; deduplication via clientMessageId; event log replay and cursor pagination verified.
capabilitiesVerified.attachments: Verified non-vault file attachments succeed; unverified, quarantined, or cross-workspace files rejected.
capabilitiesVerified.muteVsBlockVsLeave: Mute suppresses notifications only; Block hides messages for blocker and blocks mutual invites; Leave/Remove revokes access.
capabilitiesVerified.ugcReporting: In-app report captures immutable frozen evidence snapshot; duplicate clientReportId returns idempotently; reporter identity strictly confidential.
capabilitiesVerified.operatorModerationTriage: Developer dashboard at /developer/moderation with status/category filters, evidence drawer, mandatory rationale, and disposition execution.
capabilitiesVerified.contentRemovalEnforcement: RM-001: Disposition content_removed automatically soft-deletes message (body cleared, deleted_at set) and emits room_message.deleted event.
capabilitiesVerified.accessRevocationPurge: Removing member rotates access_epoch; client receives 403 MEMBERSHIP_REVOKED, halts polling, purges room cache, leaves personal items untouched.

unmetCommercialCriteria: Contracted 24/7 human moderation operations team with defined SLAs (< 1hr CSAM / severe harm, < 24hr harassment)
